title: In 2019, a YouTuber was challenged to plant millions of trees, today his campaign has planted 25 million worldwide
summary_full: MrBeast, the popular YouTuber, launched an ambitious initiative known as #TeamTrees. This groundbreaking campaign garnered viral attention, resulting in the planting of millions of trees funded by generous online donations. Partnering with various influencers and environmental organizations, it has successfully restored vast tracts of land and sequestered significant amounts of carbon. His innovative use of social media demonstrates how digital platforms can drive meaningful charitable endeavors.
